turns.text: Hi, I'm Dana. I just moved from Lisbon to Berlin for a new job at a startup called Nimbus.
I have a dog named Rex, a beagle. I need to find a vet near Prenzlauer Berg.
I'm vegetarian and I'm learning German; classes are on Tuesday evenings.
Help me make a short checklist for registering my address (Anmeldung).
Ha, the weather here is so grey compared to Lisbon.
The Anmeldung appointment is booked for next Thursday at 9am.
Correction: Rex is not a beagle, he is a basset hound.
Nimbus wants me to start on the 1st. I'm nervous about the commute; the office is in Kreuzberg.
Do you know any good podcasts about history?
What kind of restaurants should I look for near the office?
Remind me, what breed is Rex?
My sister Inês is visiting in two weeks; she's allergic to dogs, so Rex will stay with a neighbour.
I also need to open a German bank account before my first salary.
What's the tallest building in Berlin?
I got the Anmeldung done today, the appointment went fine.
My manager at Nimbus is called Priya; she leads the platform team.
Any tips for sleeping better? The sun rises so early here.
What do you remember about where I moved from and where I work?
German class moved to Wednesday evenings, starting this week.
I'm thinking of trying a pottery class for fun, no commitments though.
I opened an account at N26 this morning, so the bank thing is sorted.
Which day are my German classes now?
Rex's vet is Dr. Weber on Schönhauser Allee; first appointment next Monday.
Is it normal for shops to be closed on Sundays here?
Who is my manager and what team does she lead?
Can my sister stay at my place when she visits? Anything I should keep in mind?
Do you remember what my favourite football team is?
What still needs doing from my to-do list, and what's already done?
Where is Rex's vet and when is the appointment?
Summarise what you know about me in three sentences.
